slice 3 (1) Codec::ShuffleZstd: byte-plane shuffle (public byte_shuffle/byte_unshuffle, exact inverse for every length, remainder verbatim) then one zstd frame; manifest entry carries codec + raw_len + elem_size (2|4|8); element size derived from the tile format name (rgb_f32le, coverage_u16le, ...); per blob the smallest of raw / zstd / shuffle+zstd is stored, so shuffle is never worse than plain zstd; older manifests (no new fields) stay valid and canonical

slice 3 (1) MEASURED (ruzstd Fastest, test output): smooth linear f32 gradient 256x256 262144 B: plain zstd 262144 B (1.000x, falls back to raw) vs shuffle+zstd 31504 B (8.321x); smooth 2D f32 field 262144 B: 261813 B (1.001x) vs 196972 B (1.331x); odd-length u16 ramp 20001 B: 20001 B (1.000x) vs 1872 B (10.684x); f32 RGB image with exactly repeating rows 196608 B: plain 114902 B (1.711x), shuffle not better so plain zstd is chosen. libzstd 1.5.7 on the same shuffled gradient reaches 2693 B (ruzstd Fastest is a weaker encoder than libzstd)

slice 3 (2) EntryKind::Preview is real: Extras.previews (PreviewImage = declared PixelFormat gray8|rgb8|rgba8 + width + height + colour tag [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,64} + tightly packed pixels), stored as previews/<sha256hex> (raw or zstd), manifest-validated without decoding (dimensions 1..=max_preview_dimension, byte size == w*h*bpp and <= max_preview_bytes, decoded length matches), optional; read_package declares them in Opened.previews and NEVER reads or decodes their bodies; list_previews / read_preview / PackageReader::{previews, read_preview} fetch and digest-verify on request; verify_all and save read-back do verify them; LossReason::Preview removed (previews are no longer quarantined)

R2 fixes: Limits.max_decoded_total_bytes (default 4 GiB) summed from manifest declarations (raw_len or len) in Manifest::validate before any decode or allocation; ZIP64 locator parsed only when an EOCD sentinel announces ZIP64 (own output no longer misread when attribute/offset bytes equal the locator signature); any extra field other than the single ZIP64 record is refused (unsupported_feature) in central and local headers, ZIP64 block must be exactly consumed (no hidden bytes); file-vs-directory conflicts checked on case-folded names; consumer prints document_id via serde_json; DESCRIPTOR and limits.rs docs refreshed (api, limits with defaults, container, authority incl. Windows durability residual)

decisions: In-house STORE-only ZIP64 + crc32fast (lead decision); no mimetype entry; ASCII names; archive comments, trailing bytes, non-ZIP64 extra fields rejected
Blob table = optional per-entry fields (codec, raw_len, elem_size, preview) in the manifest, container_version stays 1, one canonical form
Shuffle selection is automatic per blob from the tile format name; unknown format names or conflicting formats for one digest fall back to plain zstd
Previews are derived data: re-saving an Opened without supplying previews drops them; they are not quarantined
Aggregate decoded bound counts previews too (conservative, although read_package never decodes them)
StdFs is not a unit struct (holds owner locks): StdFs::new()
known_gaps: Oracle independence for the container itself: own writer vs own reader; mitigated by Python zipfile acceptance, an independent raw ZIP builder in tests, and libzstd as independent encoder/decoder for zstd
ruzstd encoder verified at CompressionLevel::Fastest only; it compresses shuffled floats far worse than libzstd (31504 B vs 2693 B on the linear gradient)
Shuffle decode buffers the whole decoded blob (bounded by max_entry_bytes and the aggregate bound) because un-shuffling needs every plane

kill during the rename call itself not covered; Windows power-loss durability of the rename not provable through std (documented in DESCRIPTOR); unix parent-dir fsync failure ignored; lock-based sweep unverified on network filesystems
